<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$settings = array(
    'destination_url' => 'relative',
    'relative_path' => '/wp-pixel-art-block',
    'additional_urls' => array(),
    'exclude_urls' => array(
        site_url( '/wp-admin/' ),
        site_url( '/wp-login.php' ),
    ),
    'include_extras' => array( 'wp-css', 'wp-js' ),
    'force_inline_css' => true,
);

$simply_static = \Simply_Static\Options::instance();
foreach ( $settings as $key => $value ) {
    $simply_static->set( $key, $value );
}
$simply_static->save();

export_static_site( '/output/export.zip' );
